import json
from math import gcd

def isprime(n):
    if n < 2:
        return False
    i = 2
    while i * i <= n:
        if n % i == 0:
            return False
        i += 1
    return True

def box(a, b):  # []
    return (a - a) * b if b < 2 else (b - b) * a

def gt_lt(a, b):  # ><
    return min(a, b) if (isprime(a) or isprime(b)) else max(a, b)

def semi(a, b):  # ;
    return a * b if a + b > 0 else gt_lt(a, b)

def tilde(a, b):  # ~
    return a - b if a * b > 0 else a + b

def hash_(a, b):  # #
    return a * b if tilde(a, b) > 0 else (-a) * (-b)

def bang(a, b):  # !
    return box(a, b) if gcd(a, b) == 1 else gcd(a, b)
